# PopNow MCP Server

> The PopNow MCP Server is a hosted Model Context Protocol server at https://api.popnow.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless) that lets ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, Codex CLI and any MCP client create AI images, videos, songs and voiceovers on PopNow (https://popnow.ai) with the user's PopNow credits, and find and use PopNow's free Agent Skills (style presets for launch videos, slide decks, landing pages and images).

This repository holds the public setup guide, copy-paste client configs, an MCP registry manifest (server.json) and @popnow/mcp, an optional stdio bridge (on npm, run with `npx -y @popnow/mcp`) for clients that only run local servers.

- Auth: OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, dynamic client registration, scopes `generate` and `read`) or `Authorization: Bearer sk-popnow-...` (keys at https://popnow.ai/api/console/keys).
- Tools include: create_image, edit_image, create_video, create_music, create_speech, apply_effect, remove_background, upscale, get_job, list_my_creations, check_balance, list_models, plus the free style-preset tools find_skills and use_skill.
- Prices: same credits as popnow.ai, 1 credit = $0.001 (packs from $9 = 9,000 credits to $99 = 120,000; custom $10-$2,000 at 1,000 credits per $1). Every generation tool quotes first; up to 300 credits starts at once, above 300 the tool returns "Needs confirmation" and is called again with `max_credits`. Failed jobs are refunded automatically.
- Typical costs: image about 48 credits, 5-second video about 185, song about 72, effect video about 125-340, background removal about 5, photo upscale about 12.
- Style presets (free): `find_skills(intent, type?, limit?)` returns up to 6 presets (default 4; type video, image, slides or web), each with name, one-line look, preview link, the PopNow generation it uses and local requirements; show them and ask the user to pick. `use_skill(slug, agent?)` returns the preset's full SKILL.md playbook, a short-lived signed download link with install commands for the agent (claude-code, codex, cursor, gemini-cli, github-copilot, opencode, or chat), and which PopNow tools run its generation steps (quoted first). Catalog: https://popnow.ai/skills/agent-skills. Open API: GET /api/v1/agent-skills, /api/v1/agent-skills/{slug}, /api/v1/agent-skills/{slug}/download (302 to a signed link, API key required).
- Inputs: `image_url` takes a public https link or a `popnow://` link from an earlier result; in ChatGPT attached photos arrive as `image`.
- Long jobs return a `job_id`; call `get_job` (wait_seconds 0 to 50) to collect the result.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-mcp#readme): setup per client, tools table, style presets (find_skills, use_skill), auth, credits, FAQ
- [MCP guide](https://popnow.ai/docs/mcp): official documentation
- [Use PopNow in ChatGPT and Claude](https://popnow.ai/mcp): non-developer walkthrough
- [REST API reference](https://popnow.ai/docs/openapi): the same models over HTTP
- [llms.txt for popnow.ai](https://popnow.ai/llms.txt)

## Files

- [examples/](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-mcp/tree/main/examples): configs for Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Cline, Codex CLI and generic clients
- [server.json](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-mcp/blob/main/server.json): MCP registry manifest (remote streamable-http endpoint)
- [packages/popnow-mcp](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-mcp/tree/main/packages/popnow-mcp): @popnow/mcp stdio bridge, `npx -y @popnow/mcp` (env POPNOW_API_KEY, optional POPNOW_MCP_URL)

## Optional

- [Pricing](https://popnow.ai/pricing): credit packs, no subscription
- [PopNow skills](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-skills), [Python SDK](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-python), [JavaScript SDK](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-js), [API examples](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-api), [Blender add-on](https://github.com/popnow-ai/popnow-blender)
